vellumli.demo_book.name: Vellumli Demo Book
vellumli.demo_book.subtitle: First beta
vellumli.demo_book.landing: Welcome to $(item)Vellumli$()!$(br2)This demo book shows the core engine and the essential $(thing)page types$() ported in this first beta.$(br2)$(l:vellumli:page_types/text_page)Vellumli$(/l) is a fork of $(item)Patchouli$(), rewritten under a brand new package and resource namespace.
vellumli.demo_book.page.start.0: Vellumli is a data-driven in-game documentation mod. Modders and pack makers write JSON files and the engine turns them into a readable book, with no Java required.$(br2)This book is bundled with the mod as a demo.
vellumli.demo_book.page.start.1: Use the page turner arrows at the bottom of the book to browse.$(br2)You can also resize the book, bookmark pages, and mark entries as read from the side buttons.
vellumli.demo_book.page.text.title: Plain Text
vellumli.demo_book.page.text.0: The $(bold)text$() page is the most basic page type. It renders formatted text using Patchouli's control codes, e.g. $(item)items$(), $(thing)things$(), $(l)links$(), and even $(2)colors$().
vellumli.demo_book.page.text.1: All text here is i18n-aware: with the book's $(l)i18n$() flag enabled, strings are looked up in the language files like any other translatable string.
vellumli.demo_book.page.image.title: An Image
vellumli.demo_book.page.image.0: The $(bold)image$() page shows one or more images from any texture path. Use the small arrows to cycle between multiple images.
vellumli.demo_book.page.crafting.0: The $(bold)crafting$() page renders a vanilla crafting recipe. Click the recipe output and $(thing)shift-click$() to jump to the page that explains the item.
vellumli.demo_book.page.crafting.1: Recipes are loaded from the vanilla recipe manager, so datapack recipes work automatically.
vellumli.demo_book.page.spotlight.0: The $(bold)spotlight$() page highlights an item (or a list, or a tag). When $(l:true)link_recipe$() is set, hovering the item links it to the recipe page.
vellumli.demo_book.page.spotlight.title: Tag Spotlight
vellumli.demo_book.page.spotlight.1: Spotlights can also point at an item $(thing)tag$(), in which case the shown item cycles over the tag's contents.
vellumli.demo_book.page.relations.title: Related Chapters
vellumli.demo_book.page.relations.0: The $(bold)relations$() page lists other entries as buttons, letting readers jump between related chapters.
vellumli.demo_book.page.link.0: The $(bold)link$() page opens an external URL in the system browser when clicked. Useful to point readers at a wiki or download page.
vellumli.gui.lexicon.landing_info: (Placeholder landing text, define your own in your book json file!)
vellumli.gui.lexicon.editor.info: This is an editor for Vellumli book entries. It's meant to be used for development or translation. There's no use for it if you're a player.$(br2)Please reference the $(l:https://github.com/VazkiiMods/Patchouli/wiki/Text-Formatting-101)Patchouli wiki$() for usable control codes.
vellumli.gui.lexicon.index.info: An index of every chapter available in this book.$(br2)You may search through the index, or any other category, by simply typing in your query. A search bar will then appear to assist you.
vellumli.gui.lexicon.history.info: This section stores the previous few chapters you've visited.$(br2)Chapters are automatically added and removed as you browse through the book. Should you wish to keep them referenced for longer, you may bookmark them. $(br2)$(o)Tip: Try shift-clicking a chapter button!$()
vellumli.gui.lexicon.button.resize.veryb: How large is your monitor even
